questions.stem: The figure shows a rectangle with length \((3x^2+x-2)\,\mathrm{cm}\) and width \((x-1)\,\mathrm{cm}\). Find its perimeter in terms of \(x\).
questions.stemZh: 圖中的長方形長 \((3x^2+x-2)\,\mathrm{cm}\)，闊 \((x-1)\,\mathrm{cm}\)。以 \(x\) 表示其周界。
questions.solution: The perimeter is twice the sum of adjacent sides: \[\begin{gathered}2[(3x^2+x-2)+(x-1)] \\ =6x^2 +4x -6\end{gathered}\]. Thus the answer is \((6x^2+4x-6)\,\mathrm{cm}\).
questions.solutionZh: 周界為兩相鄰邊之和的兩倍：\[\begin{gathered}2[(3x^2+x-2)+(x-1)] \\ =6x^2 +4x -6\end{gathered}\]，所以答案為 \((6x^2+4x-6)\,\mathrm{cm}\)。

questions.solution: Subtract the uninstalled number and add the installed number: \[\begin{gathered}(3x+2y) -(x+8y) \\ +(2x-12y) =4x -18y\end{gathered}\].

questions.stem: Simplify \(\frac{(-2x^2y^3)^3}{8x^7y}\).
questions.solution: The odd power retains the negative sign: \[\begin{gathered}(-2x^2y^3)^3 = \\ -8x^6y^9\end{gathered}\]. Dividing by \(8x^7y\) gives \(-\frac{y^8}{x}\), for \(x,y\ne0\).
questions.solutionZh: 奇數次冪保留負號：\[\begin{gathered}(-2x^2y^3)^3 = \\ -8x^6y^9\end{gathered}\]。再除以 \(8x^7y\) 得 \(-\frac{y^8}{x}\)（\(x,y\ne0\)）。

questions.stem: If \[\begin{gathered}(x^my^2)^5 \\ =x^{10}y^n\end{gathered}\], where \(m,n\) are positive integers, find \(m,n\).
questions.stemZh: 若 \[\begin{gathered}(x^my^2)^5 \\ =x^{10}y^n\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(m,n\) 為正整數，求 \(m,n\)。
questions.solution: Expand the left side as \(x^{5m}y^{10}\). Comparing exponents gives \(5m=10\) and \(n=10\), so \(m=2,n=10\).

questions.stem:
Mr Pang teaches \((x+2)\) classes, with \((2x+7)\) students in each class. He buys each student a gift costing HKD \(2x\).
(a) Express the total cost in terms of \(x\).
(b) Find the total cost when each gift costs HKD10.
questions.stemZh:
彭老師任教 \((x+2)\) 班，每班有 \((2x+7)\) 位學生，並為每人買一份售價港幣 \(2x\) 元的禮物。
(a) 以 \(x\) 表示總開支。
(b) 若每份禮物售價港幣 10 元，求總開支。
questions.solution:
(a) Number of students is \((x+2)(2x+7)\). Multiply by the unit price: \[\begin{gathered}2x(x+2)(2x+7) =4x^3 \\ +22x^2 +28x\end{gathered}\]. Total cost is HKD \((4x^3+22x^2+28x)\).
(b) From \(2x=10\), \(x=5\). There are 7 classes of 17 students, so the cost is HKD \((7)(17)(10)=1190\).
questions.source: S1/polynomials/polynomial review.pdf · Q18
questions.sourceZh: S1/polynomials/polynomial review.pdf · 第18題

questions.stem:
The figure shows an isosceles triangle \(ABC\) with \(AB=BC\). Its side \(AC\) is \((2x+4y)\,\mathrm{cm}\) and its perimeter is \((8x+10y)\,\mathrm{cm}\).
(a) Express \(AB\) in terms of \(x,y\).
(b) Find all side lengths when \(x=3,y=1\).
(c) Emily claims that the triangle is equilateral when \(x=1,y=1\). Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
圖中的等腰三角形 \(ABC\) 滿足 \(AB=BC\)。邊 \(AC\) 長 \((2x+4y)\,\mathrm{cm}\)，周界為 \((8x+10y)\,\mathrm{cm}\)。
(a) 以 \(x,y\) 表示 \(AB\)。
(b) 當 \(x=3,y=1\) 時，求三邊長。
(c) Emily 聲稱當 \(x=1,y=1\) 時，三角形為等邊三角形。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) Since \(AB=BC\), \[\begin{gathered}2AB =(8x+10y) \\ -(2x+4y) =6x +6y\end{gathered}\]. Thus \[\begin{gathered}AB \\ =(3x+3y)\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\].
(b) \[\begin{gathered}AB =BC \\ =(3\cdot3+3\cdot1)\,\mathrm{cm} \\ =12\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\], while \[\begin{gathered}AC \\ =(2\cdot3+4\cdot1)\,\mathrm{cm} \\ =10\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\].
(c) Agree. At \(x=y=1\), \[\begin{gathered}AB =BC \\ =6\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\] and \(AC=6\,\mathrm{cm}\), so all three sides are equal.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 由 \(AB=BC\)，得 \[\begin{gathered}2AB =(8x+10y) \\ -(2x+4y) =6x +6y\end{gathered}\]，故 \[\begin{gathered}AB \\ =(3x+3y)\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\]。
(b) \[\begin{gathered}AB =BC \\ =(3\cdot3+3\cdot1)\,\mathrm{cm} \\ =12\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\]，\[\begin{gathered}AC \\ =(2\cdot3+4\cdot1)\,\mathrm{cm} \\ =10\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\]。
(c) 同意。當 \(x=y=1\)，\[\begin{gathered}AB =BC \\ =6\,\mathrm{cm}\end{gathered}\] 且 \(AC=6\,\mathrm{cm}\)，三邊相等，故為等邊三角形。
questions.source: S1/polynomials/polynomial review.pdf · Q19

questions.stem:
It is given that \(f(x)\) is a polynomial function of degree 3 such that \(f(2)=4\) and \(f(3)=f(6)=0\). Which statements may be true?
I. \(x-3\) is a factor of \(f(x)\).
II. When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-2\), the remainder is 4.
III. \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x-1)(x-3)(x-6)\end{gathered}\].
questions.stemZh:
已知三次多項式函數 \(f(x)\) 滿足 \(f(2)=4\) 及 \(f(3)=f(6)=0\)。下列哪些敘述可能正確？
I. \(x-3\) 是 \(f(x)\) 的因式。
II. \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-2\) 除的餘式為 4。
III. \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x-1)(x-3)(x-6)\end{gathered}\]。
questions.solution: I follows from the factor theorem and II from the remainder theorem. The cubic in III has zeros 3 and 6 and takes the value \((2-1)(2-3)(2-6)=4\) at 2. All three may be true.
questions.solutionZh: I 由因式定理成立，II 由餘式定理成立。III 的三次式在 3、6 為零，且在 2 的值為 \((2-1)(2-3)(2-6)=4\)。三項均可能正確。
questions.source: S4/more about polynomials/S4 polynomials review.pdf · Q1
questions.sourceZh: S4/more about polynomials/S4 polynomials review.pdf · 第1題

questions.stem: Let \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =x^4 +ax^2 +x \\ +b\end{gathered}\], where \(a,b\) are constants. If \(g(x)\) is divisible by \(3x+2\), find the remainder on division by \(3x-2\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =x^4 +ax^2 +x \\ +b\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(a,b\) 為常數。若 \(g(x)\) 可被 \(3x+2\) 整除，求它被 \(3x-2\) 除的餘式。
questions.solution: The even-power terms cancel in \(g(2/3)-g(-2/3)\). The difference is \(4/3\). Since \(g(-2/3)=0\), the required remainder is \(4/3\).

questions.stem: The remainders when a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-2\) and \(x+3\) are 3 and 8 respectively. Find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x^2+x-6\).
questions.stemZh: 多項式 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-2\) 及 \(x+3\) 除的餘式分別為 3 及 8。求它被 \(x^2+x-6\) 除的餘式。
questions.solution: Factor the divisor as \((x-2)(x+3)\) and let the remainder be \(ux+v\). Then \(2u+v=3\) and \(-3u+v=8\). Solving gives \(u=-1,v=5\), so the remainder is \(-x+5\).

questions.stem: A degree-4 polynomial \(f(x)\) has remainders 1, 5 and 3 when divided by \(x\), \(x+1\) and \(x-1\) respectively. Find the remainder on division by \(x^3-x\).
questions.stemZh: 四次多項式 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x\)、\(x+1\)、\(x-1\) 除的餘式依次為 1、5、3。求它被 \(x^3-x\) 除的餘式。
questions.solution: The divisor is \(x(x-1)(x+1)\), so let the remainder be \(ux^2+vx+w\). At 0, \(w=1\); at \(-1\), \(u-v=4\); at 1, \(u+v=2\). Thus \(u=3,v=-1\) and the remainder is \(3x^2-x+1\).

questions.stem:
Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of the following expressions:
\(10a^2bc^2\)
\(12a^3b^3\)
questions.stemZh:
求以下各式的最大公因式及最小公倍式：
\(10a^2bc^2\)
\(12a^3b^3\)
questions.solution:
The coefficient gcd/lcm are 2 and 60. Take minimum/maximum exponents of each variable; \(c\) is absent from the second expression.
H.C.F.: \(2a^2b\).
L.C.M.: \(60a^3b^3c^2\).
questions.solutionZh:
係數的最大公因數／最小公倍數為 2、60，各變量取最低／最高指數；第二式不含 \(c\)。
最大公因式：\(2a^2b\)。
最小公倍式：\(60a^3b^3c^2\)。

questions.stem:
Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of the following expressions:
\(9r(r-s)^2(r+2s)\)
\(12s^2(r-s)(r+2s)^3\)
questions.stemZh:
求以下各式的最大公因式及最小公倍式：
\(9r(r-s)^2(r+2s)\)
\(12s^2(r-s)(r+2s)^3\)
questions.solution:
Only the two shared brackets enter the H.C.F., at their minimum power 1. The L.C.M. uses coefficient 36 and all factors at their maximum powers.
H.C.F.: \(3(r-s)(r+2s)\).
L.C.M.: \[\begin{gathered}36rs^2 \cdot(r-s)^2 \\ \cdot(r+2s)^3\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh:
最大公因式只取共同括號，最低次冪均為 1；最小公倍式取係數 36 及全部因式的最高次冪。
最大公因式：\(3(r-s)(r+2s)\)。
最小公倍式：\[\begin{gathered}36rs^2 \cdot(r-s)^2 \\ \cdot(r+2s)^3\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem:
Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of the following expressions:
\(8p^2-12pq-8q^2\)
\(p^3-p^2q-2pq^2\)
\(4p^2q+6pq^2+2q^3\)
questions.stemZh:
求以下各式的最大公因式及最小公倍式：
\(8p^2-12pq-8q^2\)
\(p^3-p^2q-2pq^2\)
\(4p^2q+6pq^2+2q^3\)
questions.solution:
The factorizations are \(4(2p+q)(p-2q)\), \(p(p-2q)(p+q)\) and \(2q(2p+q)(p+q)\). No factor is shared by all three. Use every distinct factor once and coefficient lcm 4.
H.C.F.: \(1\).
L.C.M.: \[\begin{gathered}4pq \cdot(p+q) \\ \cdot(p-2q) \\ \cdot(2p+q)\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh:
三式分別為 \(4(2p+q)(p-2q)\)、\(p(p-2q)(p+q)\)、\(2q(2p+q)(p+q)\)。沒有三式共有的因式；最小公倍式取全部相異因式各一次，係數取 4。
最大公因式：\(1\)。
最小公倍式：\[\begin{gathered}4pq \cdot(p+q) \\ \cdot(p-2q) \\ \cdot(2p+q)\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem: The H.C.F. and L.C.M. of three polynomials are \(4x^2-4x+1\) and \[\begin{gathered}36(2x-1)^3 \\ \cdot(2x+1)^4 \\ \cdot(2x+3)^2\end{gathered}\] respectively. Two of them are \(4(2x-1)^2(2x+1)^3\) and \(6(2x-1)^2(2x+3)\). Find the third.
questions.stemZh: 三多項式的最大公因式及最小公倍式分別為 \(4x^2-4x+1\) 及 \[\begin{gathered}36(2x-1)^3 \\ \cdot(2x+1)^4 \\ \cdot(2x+3)^2\end{gathered}\]。其中兩式為 \(4(2x-1)^2(2x+1)^3\) 及 \(6(2x-1)^2(2x+3)\)，求第三式。
questions.solution: The H.C.F. is \((2x-1)^2\). For coefficients, the third positive coefficient must have lcm 36 with 4 and 6 and gcd 1 with them, hence it is 9. The third expression must supply the missing maximum powers 3,4,2 of the three bracket factors. Thus it is \[\begin{gathered}9(2x-1)^3 \\ \cdot(2x+1)^4 \\ \cdot(2x+3)^2\end{gathered}\]. Checking all three gives the stated H.C.F. and L.C.M.
questions.solutionZh: 最大公因式為 \((2x-1)^2\)。第三式的正係數與 4、6 的最小公倍數須為 36、最大公因數須為 1，因此為 9。三個括號因式的最高指數 3、4、2 均須由第三式提供，故為 \[\begin{gathered}9(2x-1)^3 \\ \cdot(2x+1)^4 \\ \cdot(2x+3)^2\end{gathered}\]。代回三式核對可得原定的最大公因式及最小公倍式。

questions.stem:
Two degree-2 polynomials have H.C.F. \(3x-2\) and L.C.M. \(6x^3+5x^2-3x-2\).
(a) Factorise the L.C.M.
(b) Find the two polynomials.
questions.stemZh:
兩個二次多項式的最大公因式為 \(3x-2\)，最小公倍式為 \(6x^3+5x^2-3x-2\)。
(a) 把最小公倍式因式分解。
(b) 求兩個多項式。
questions.solution:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}6x^3 +5x^2 -3x -2 \\ =(3x-2)(2x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\].
(b) Each quadratic contains the common linear factor and one of the other factors. The standard primitive representatives are \[\begin{gathered}(3x-2)(2x+1) =6x^2 \\ -x -2\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}(3x-2)(x+1) =3x^2 \\ +x -2\end{gathered}\] (in either order). Nonzero scalar multiples are equivalent if H.C.F./L.C.M. are defined only up to units.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}6x^3 +5x^2 -3x -2 \\ =(3x-2)(2x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]。
(b) 每個二次式包含共同的一次因式及餘下其中一個因式。取標準本原代表，兩式為 \[\begin{gathered}(3x-2)(2x+1) =6x^2 \\ -x -2\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}(3x-2)(x+1) =3x^2 \\ +x -2\end{gathered}\]，次序可互換。若公因式／公倍式只定義至非零常數倍，則相應常數倍視為等價。

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =4x^3 -24x^2 \\ +17x +15\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6x^3 -35x^2 \\ +19x +30\end{gathered}\].
(a) Show that \(2x-3\) is a common factor.
(b) Factorise both polynomials.
(c) Find their H.C.F. and L.C.M.
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =4x^3 -24x^2 \\ +17x +15\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6x^3 -35x^2 \\ +19x +30\end{gathered}\]。
(a) 證明 \(2x-3\) 是公因式。
(b) 把兩式因式分解。
(c) 求它們的最大公因式及最小公倍式。
questions.solution:
(a) Direct substitution gives \(f(3/2)=g(3/2)=0\), so \(2x-3\) divides both.
(b) Division gives \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x-3)(2x^2-9x-5) \\ =(2x-3)(x-5)(2x+1)\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(2x-3)(3x^2-13x-10) \\ =(2x-3)(x-5)(3x+2)\end{gathered}\].
(c) H.C.F. \((2x-3)(x-5)\); L.C.M. \[\begin{gathered}(2x-3) \cdot(x-5) \\ \cdot(2x+1) \\ \cdot(3x+2)\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 直接代入得 \(f(3/2)=g(3/2)=0\)，故 \(2x-3\) 是公因式。
(b) 相除後得 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x-3)(2x^2-9x-5) \\ =(2x-3)(x-5)(2x+1)\end{gathered}\]，\[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(2x-3)(3x^2-13x-10) \\ =(2x-3)(x-5)(3x+2)\end{gathered}\]。
(c) 最大公因式為 \((2x-3)(x-5)\)；最小公倍式為 \[\begin{gathered}(2x-3) \cdot(x-5) \\ \cdot(2x+1) \\ \cdot(3x+2)\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem:
It is given that \(3x+1\) is a common factor of \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =12x^3 +49x^2 \\ +mx -n\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6nx^3 -34x^2 \\ -5x +m\end{gathered}\], where \(m,n\) are constants.
(a) Find \(m,n\).
(b) Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of \(f(x),g(x)\).
questions.stemZh:
已知 \(3x+1\) 是 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =12x^3 +49x^2 \\ +mx -n\end{gathered}\] 及 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) =6nx^3 -34x^2 \\ -5x +m\end{gathered}\] 的公因式，其中 \(m,n\) 為常數。
(a) 求 \(m,n\)。
(b) 求兩式的最大公因式及最小公倍式。
questions.solution:
(a) Set \(x=-1/3\). The equations reduce to \(m+3n=15\) and \(9m-2n=19\), giving \(m=3,n=4\).
(b) Factor to get \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(x+4)\end{gathered}\] and \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(2x-3)\end{gathered}\]. H.C.F. \((3x+1)(4x-1)\); L.C.M. \[\begin{gathered}(3x+1) \cdot(4x-1) \\ \cdot(x+4) \\ \cdot(2x-3)\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 代 \(x=-1/3\)，兩式化為 \(m+3n=15\)、\(9m-2n=19\)，得 \(m=3,n=4\)。
(b) 因式分解得 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(x+4)\end{gathered}\]、\[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(3x+1)(4x-1)(2x-3)\end{gathered}\]。最大公因式為 \((3x+1)(4x-1)\)，最小公倍式為 \[\begin{gathered}(3x+1) \cdot(4x-1) \\ \cdot(x+4) \\ \cdot(2x-3)\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem: If a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-k\), then \(f(3x)\) is divisible by which expression?
questions.stemZh: 若多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-k\) 整除，則 \(f(3x)\) 可被下列哪式整除？
questions.solution: Let \(g(x)=f(3x)\). As \(f(k)=0\), \(g(k/3)=0\). By the factor theorem, \(x-\frac{k}{3}\) is a factor.

questions.stem: Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =x^{2014} +ax \\ +b\end{gathered}\], where \(a,b\) are constants. The remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x+1\) is 3. Find \(2a-2b+1\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =x^{2014} +ax \\ +b\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(a,b\) 為常數。\(f(x)\) 被 \(x+1\) 除的餘式為 3，求 \(2a-2b+1\)。
questions.solution: From \(f(-1)=3\), \(1-a+b=3\), so \(a-b=-2\). Thus \[\begin{gathered}2a -2b +1 =2(-2) +1 \\ = -3\end{gathered}\].

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=ax^2+bx+c\). If \(f(x+1)-f(x)\) is divisible by \(2x+1\), find \(b\).
questions.solution: Expansion gives \[\begin{gathered}f(x+1) -f(x) \\ =a(2x+1) +b\end{gathered}\]. Its remainder on division by \(2x+1\) is \(b\), hence \(b=0\).
questions.solutionZh: 展開得 \[\begin{gathered}f(x+1) -f(x) \\ =a(2x+1) +b\end{gathered}\]，故除以 \(2x+1\) 的餘式為 \(b\)。可整除表示 \(b=0\)。
